summary: Iteration 4 (Withdrawals, KYC, Bulk Credit) verified across backend and frontend. All 3 new capabilities work end-to-end. 11/11 targeted checks passed.
passed: Backend POST /withdrawals with zero unlocked capital returns 400 with 'Only ₹0 available for withdrawal'
Backend POST /withdrawals succeeds (status=pending) after backdating lock_until on an approved deposit via Mongo
Backend GET /withdrawals/my returns the pending withdrawal for the client
Backend GET /admin/withdrawals/pending lists pending withdrawal with user_name and user_email
Backend non-admin POST /admin/withdrawals/{id}/approve => 403; admin approve => 200 ok:true
Backend POST /admin/clients/{id}/kyc invalid status => 400; verified => 200; GET /admin/clients/{id}.user.kyc_status='verified'

Backend POST /admin/bulk-credit-profit empty body => 400; rate_percent=0.1 credits N clients (returns credited_clients, total_credited); flat_amount=100 credits all clients ₹100 each; client /profits/my grows accordingly
Frontend Admin dashboard shows bulk-credit-panel with bulk-rate-input and bulk-credit-button (verified via data-testids)
Frontend Bulk Credit button clickable with rate 0.1 (no UI error; backend returns success)
Frontend Admin client detail shows KYC Status: VERIFIED badge with Verify/Reject buttons; clicking Verify shows 'KYC Verified' toast and badge updates
Frontend Client dashboard has withdraw-button below Request Deposit; clicking with amount 500 shows toast 'Only ₹0 available for withdrawal'
notes: Bulk credit toast text was not explicitly parsed by the automation but backend call succeeds and admin panel functions correctly (no console/API errors). KYC field is nested at response.user.kyc_status in GET /admin/clients/{id}.
